=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:896-912 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: triage_run_failed_job_names() counts every conclusion other than success/skipped/neutral (including cancelled, timed_out) as failed, so the base-tracked skip can wrongly match a PR's real failure against a cancelled base job and suppress the per-PR issue.
  WHY: Severity disagreement (MAJOR in three reviewers, unstated in gemini); highest used; the sonnet reviewer examined this and chose not to report it (narrow, matches main, inert on stable). Fix suggested: restrict to conclusion == "failure".
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3597-3668 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: post_state_comment returns failure on a failed chunk POST without updating or clearing the persisted state hash, so a later write returning to the previously recorded state is skipped as unchanged.
  WHY: Severity disagreement (MAJOR in openai, NIT in z-ai, unstated in gemini); highest used; narrow window if the POST was accepted but the response was lost.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:952-957 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: A failed base-tracked note POST is only logged and the stage exits 0 (with continue-on-error: true in .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:657-668), after the per-PR issue was already skipped, so the PR failure is recorded nowhere.
  WHY: Severity disagreement (MAJOR in openai and z-ai, NIT in sonnet); highest used.
- README.md:2749-2752 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The README row for CHECK_TRIAGE_SKIP_FINAL_CI_ENABLED, and the comment blocks in scripts/check_failure_triage.sh (1236-1244, 63-66), describe a final-ci-failed hand-back and cite scripts that do not exist on stable.
  WHY: The gate is inert on stable and in consumers, so the docs overpromise; all reviewers rated NIT.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1655-1664 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On stable, workflow_failure_heal.py writes no workflow= heal header, so triage_base_failure_heal_issue can never match, yet each qualifying triage pays one extra heal-issue listing REST read, and the README row CHECK_TRIAGE_BASE_TRACKED_SKIP_ENABLED (lines 2753-2754) presents the skip as active.
  WHY: Wasted API read (§14) and overpromising docs; all reviewers rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md:variable-table row CHECK_TRIAGE_SKIP_FINAL_CI_ENABLED and scripts/check_failure_triage.sh final-CI gate comment | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The row and comment describe a final-ci-failed hand-back citing scripts that do not exist on stable.
  WHY: The gate never fires on stable or in consumers, so the README is misleading.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:base-tracked skip (triage_base_failure_heal_issue call) and README row CHECK_TRIAGE_BASE_TRACKED_SKIP_ENABLED | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Stable writes no workflow= heal header, so the skip never fires, yet the README presents it as active.
  WHY: Each qualifying triage pays one wasted GET issues read that ends in reason=no_open_heal_issue.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:base-tracked-note stage final POST branch | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed note POST is only logged and the step exits 0 under continue-on-error.
  WHY: The PR's failure signal is silently dropped, mitigated by the review/autofix loop and the dormant path.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:896 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: triage_run_failed_job_names() treats cancelled jobs as failures.
  WHY: A cancelled base job can make the skip logic wrongly infer the base already tracks the PR's failure, so the real failure is skipped.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3600-3668 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The persistence hash is only updated or cleared at the end of post_state_comment(), which returns early on failure.
  WHY: The old state's hash remains, so a later attempt wrongly concludes the state is unchanged and never posts the new state.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:907-912 (triage_run_failed_job_names jq filter) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The select filters out only success/skipped/neutral, so cancelled, timed_out, action_required, stale and startup_failure count as failures in the base-tracked comparison.
  WHY: A cancelled base job matches a same-named PR job that really failed, so the skip fires and a PR-specific triage issue is dropped; the new tests do not cover these conclusions.
- README.md:2749-2752 (CHECK_TRIAGE_SKIP_FINAL_CI_ENABLED row); scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:~1236-1244 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The row and comment reference final-ci-failed and review_final_ci_*.sh, which do not exist on stable.
  WHY: Consumers are told a hand-back is active when the switch is a no-op; the agents.d fragment already scopes it correctly.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:~1655-1664 and README.md:2753-2754 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Stable has no workflow= heal header, so triage_base_failure_heal_issue always returns empty.
  WHY: Each qualifying triage pays one extra REST read that cannot match, and the README documents the switch as productive.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:907-912, 1655-1664 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The base-tracked skip treats every conclusion other than success/skipped/neutral, including cancelled, as failure.
  WHY: A fail-fast cancelled base job passes the subset check against a PR-specific failure, so the per-PR issue is suppressed.
- README.md:2750 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The docs cite ci.yml's final-ci-failed job and review sweep, which do not exist on stable.
  WHY: Stable users are told about a hand-back path stable lacks.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3599-3605, 3643-3659, 3666-3668 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed chunk POST leaves the previous persisted hash intact even when GitHub accepted the POST and the response was lost.
  WHY: A later write returning to the recorded state is skipped as unchanged even though the newest chain holds an intervening state.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:952-957; .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:659-668 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A failed heal-issue note POST is logged but the stage exits successfully under continue-on-error: true.
  WHY: The per-PR issue was already skipped, so no PR reference is added and the note is not retried.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:907-912 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq filter counts cancelled, timed_out, startup_failure and action_required as failed, so the base-tracked skip (~1645-1664) can match a PR's real failure against a base job that never failed.
  WHY: Fail-fast cancelled siblings on main make every PR failed job name appear failed on main, so skip reason=base_failure_tracked fires and no per-PR issue is filed.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:952-957; .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml:657-667 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A note POST that fails after gh_retry exhausts logs op=base_tracked_note outcome=failed and exits 0 under continue-on-error: true.
  WHY: The per-PR issue was already skipped and the note never lands, so the failure is recorded only in a log line.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3643-3646, 3657-3668, 3842-3862 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: record_state_persisted_sha runs only after all chunk POSTs succeed, so a transport error after the server accepted the final chunk leaves a stale hash.
  WHY: A later reversion to the older state is skipped as unchanged within the failing run; the next poll self-heals, and the code comment's claim does not hold for this case.
- README.md:2750; scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1236-1244, 63-66 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The docs and comments describe a final-CI hand-back that does not exist on stable, and the README presents the base-tracked skip (CHECK_TRIAGE_BASE_TRACKED_SKIP_ENABLED row) as able to match while stable has no workflow= header.
  WHY: Both gates are fail-safe no-ops on stable, but consumers are misled and each qualifying triage pays one wasted heal-issue read.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
